LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContractMaintained.stages.0: I formed a contract with {PAWN_nameDef} under Luoshen's witness. Being with {PAWN_nameDef} makes me feel at peace.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContractMaintained.stages.1: Luoshen's words still echo in my heart. My destined one has yet to arrive.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContractBroken.stages.0.des: The contract I maintained with {OTHERPAWN_nameDef} has broken. The voices that once resonated now echo hollowly.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QingheInstrumentPerformance.stages: Qinghe's music moved softly through the room, easing the mind.
The Lotus Rain Pavilion verse was clear and gentle, like hearing an old tender melody in a pavilion after rain.
LanguageData.MX_QH_NoLotusPond.stages.0.label: no lotus pond
LanguageData.MX_QH_NoLotusPond.stages.0.description: There is no lotus pond nearby where Qinghe can settle her heart. The water intent has nowhere to rest.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusPavilionBeautyLow.stages.0.de: The room around the lotus pond is not yet graceful enough for Qinghe to truly quiet her heart.
